integrity: All simplices are reconstructed from field operations; exact boundary Smith forms and compositions are reproducibly checked by the attached program and recorded output. Mathematical topological upgrade is in the written proof. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact homotopy type only for the 13-point projective plane of order three and the unordered alternating simplicial cap complex.
The wedge decomposition is nonequivariant. The homology of ordered-injective-tuple complexes, higher plane orders and complex-projective configuration spaces is not determined.
The three Smith factors equal to three are established by exhaustive exact integer computation, not a noncomputational closed formula.
Publication priority and mathematical validity have not been independently checked.
title: Three mod-three Moore summands in the \(\mathrm{PG}(2,3)\) cap complex
